name: Greater Manchester
tagline: Cranes, cyber and care: match your A levels to Greater Manchester's fastest-growing jobs.
lsip_title: Greater Manchester Local Skills Improvement Plan
summary: Greater Manchester is the UK's fastest-growing sub-regional economy (GVA £96bn, up 46% since 2011), built on digital and tech, advanced manufacturing and graphene, health innovation, financial and professional services, construction, and creative and media around MediaCity Salford. Its LSIP responds to employers who say training uptake, careers advice, leadership skills, digital skills and engineering shortages are holding back growth, and sets out sector-specific fixes for construction, logistics, health and social care, engineering and manufacturing, digital and technology, creative and media, hospitality, and financial, business and professional services.
